## Summary
- adds AuthFn migration support across core, client, Svelte, Swift, native handoff, regional routing, account admin, and lookup adapters
- adds Cloudflare DO and DynamoDB region lookup adapters plus cache/schema support in shared packages
- moves DataFn docs updates and CLI/schema-codec support needed by the AuthFn work

## Notes
- root package manifests were reconciled from origin/dev instead of copied from next; only authfn/adapters/* was added to the workspace list
- authfn/docs was intentionally left out because it depends on next-only docsfn packages that are not present on dev

## Validation
- npm install --ignore-scripts
- built workspace deps: @superfunctions/auth, @superfunctions/db, @superfunctions/http, @superfunctions/http-openapi, @superfunctions/oauth-core, @superfunctions/oauth-http, @superfunctions/oauth-storage, @superfunctions/oauth-providers, @superfunctions/oauth-flow
- npm --workspace @authfn/core test -- src/__tests__/multi-region.test.ts src/__tests__/native-handoff.test.ts src/__tests__/otp.test.ts src/__tests__/password.test.ts src/__tests__/social-google.test.ts src/__tests__/social-apple.test.ts
- npm --workspace @authfn/lookup-dynamodb test
- npm --workspace @authfn/core run typecheck
- npm --workspace @authfn/core run build && npm --workspace @authfn/lookup-dynamodb run typecheck
- npm --workspace @superfunctions/db run typecheck
- npm --workspace @superfunctions/db test -- src/adapter/__tests__/schema-codecs.test.ts src/adapters/cloudflare-kv/index.test.ts
- npm --workspace @superfunctions/cli test -- src/__tests__/authfn-schema-discovery.test.ts src/__tests__/discover-configs.test.ts
- npm --workspace @superfunctions/cli run typecheck
- npm --workspace @superfunctions/oauth-core test -- tests/oauth-core.test.ts
- npm --workspace @superfunctions/oauth-providers test -- tests/provider-runtime.test.ts
- npm --workspace @authfn/client test -- src/__tests__/regional-client.test.ts src/__tests__/client-otp.test.ts src/__tests__/client-password.test.ts src/__tests__/client-social.test.ts src/__tests__/client-account-settings.test.ts
- npm --workspace @authfn/svelte test -- src/__tests__/session-store.test.ts
- git diff --check

## Known validation note
- @authfn/svelte has no typecheck script, so validation for it is the focused session-store test.

## Summary by cubic
Adds AuthFn migration support across core, clients, and adapters with multi‑region lookup, native handoff, and account/admin APIs. This fulfills SF-33 by enabling regional routing, web‑to‑native sign‑in, and simple user management.

- **New Features**
  - Core: multi‑region lookup store with cache; account endpoints (`GET /account`, `DELETE /account`); native handoff plugin; OAuth robustness and safer error mapping.
  - Adapters: `@authfn/lookup-dynamodb` and `@authfn/lookup-cloudflare-do` for region lookup.
  - Web client: new `createAuthFnClient` methods (`getAccountDetails`, `deleteAccount`, OTP sign‑up); regional client (`createAuthFnRegionalClient`) with retry on region mismatch; optional bearer token.
  - Svelte: session store now exposes state (`{ loading, session, authenticated, regionId, error }`) and helpers.
  - Admin: `@authfn/admin` with routes to list users and delete by ID/email; pluggable authorizers.
  - Swift: `AuthFnClient`, SwiftUI model, and WebView bridge for native handoff and OAuth.
  - Docs: DataFn docs restructured (Capabilities, Namespaces, Getting Started); Mermaid component stabilized.

- **Migration**
  - Svelte session store now returns an object; read `store.session` and `store.authenticated` instead of the store value being the session.
  - OAuth: the client no longer forces `callbackMode: 'json'`; servers infer mode. Update apps that depended on the previous default.
  - Multi‑region: configure a lookup store in the multi‑region plugin and, if needed, install `@authfn/lookup-dynamodb` or `@authfn/lookup-cloudflare-do`. Optionally attach a KV cache store.
  - Web‑native handoff: enable the native handoff plugin and expose its routes; Swift clients can consume/exchange handoff codes.
  - Account APIs: use `client.getAccountDetails()` and `client.deleteAccount()` (DELETE requires CSRF). Adjust UIs/messages for new envelopes.
  - Account linking: new policies (password for authenticated user, OAuth by verified email). Set desired behavior in config.

<sup>Written for commit 3a38839aac7b08ade844f8ec91657e5345793344. Summary will update on new commits.</sup>

<!-- End of auto-generated description by cubic. -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

## Release Notes

* **New Features**
  * Added admin user management interface with listing, deletion by ID, and deletion by email
  * Introduced account details retrieval and account deletion functionality
  * Added regional client with automatic region detection and retry logic for region mismatches
  * Implemented native-to-web and web-to-native handoff flows
  * Added session token support and configurable session modes (cookie, bearer, hybrid)
  * Introduced Swift SDK with credential storage and WebView bridge support
  * Added support for OTP sign-up and account linking policies
  * Implemented region lookup caching with DynamoDB and Cloudflare Durable Objects backends

* **Enhancements**
  * Improved session store with enhanced state tracking including authentication and region information
  * Enhanced error handling with structured observability events for account operations
  * Added Apple native sign-in and form_post OAuth flows
  * Expanded email OTP with metadata and profile support during verification
  * Improved database adapter with date/datetime field handling and Cloudflare KV support

* **Documentation**
  * Restructured documentation architecture with new capabilities and namespaces sections
  * Added comprehensive getting started guide with setup examples for backend and client
